forecast_outage_policy: Exclude a whole valid date only when every missing (valid_date, lead_days) combination is absent for every requested cell; reject any partial-cell gap and never fill values.
leakage_policy: Observed antecedent inputs are restricted by the feature builder to data genuinely available at the reference day. Forecast inputs use the Open-Meteo reference run plus previous_day1..7 fixed 24-hour offsets; these are explicitly an approximation, not exact issue runs. Climatology is fixed to 2015-2023 and target-day observations are labels only.

previous_runs.forecast_outage_policy: Exclude a whole valid date only when every missing (valid_date, lead_days) combination is absent for every requested cell; reject any partial-cell gap and never fill values.
